subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw accept Pioneer as an official provider now, and may this PR add default Gateway catalog warming plus dependency graph changes to support first-open live discovery?
rationale: The remaining blockers are maintainer-owned product/security choices: official provider ownership, publishing/dependency approval, and whether broad Gateway startup discovery is acceptable.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the provider/plugin path, but remove or gate broad Gateway startup warming and the 30s picker timeout, then merge only after dependency/security approval is visible.

options.title: Accept as-is with approval
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly own the official provider, dependency graph, startup API traffic, and longer picker wait as intentional behavior.

options.title: Route externally first
options.body: Ask for a self-maintained ClawHub/npm provider package and land only any generic missing external-provider API improvements separately.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the provider/plugin path, but remove or gate broad Gateway startup warming and the 30s picker timeout, then merge only after dependency/security approval is visible.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and maintainer-facing PR history cover both provider-auth startup defaults and model browse catalog behavior.
